items.title: aj 未授权访问致RCE
items.summary_zh: 未授权攻击者可访问服务并执行任意代码，完全控制受影响服务器
items.action_zh: 升级至2.2.13，限制服务暴露面
items.repro_note: 未授权访问服务并执行代码，具体入口需审计源码
items.impact_scope: 开源服务组件，暴露公网易失陷
items.description: ### Impact An unauthenticated user could gain access to a server to execute arbitrary code on this server. ### Patches This is fixed in the version 2.2.13. Users should upgrade to this version as soon as possible.

items.title: NeMo Agent 缺失认证
items.summary_zh: 未授权攻击者可访问NeMo Agent Toolkit接口，可能导致代码执行与数据泄露
items.action_zh: 安装最新版本并限制服务网络暴露
items.repro_note: 未授权访问Toolkit服务接口，具体入口待确认
items.impact_scope: AI工具链服务，内网部署易横向
items.description: NVIDIA NeMo Agent Toolkit contains a vulnerability where a attacker could cause a missing authentication issue. This vulnerability might lead to code execution, escalation of privileges, data tampering, denial of service, and information disclosure.

items.title: litellm 权限提升致RCE
items.summary_zh: 内部普通用户可伪造管理员凭据创建API Key，提权至proxy_admin并执行代码
items.repro_note: 以internal_user创建API Key，在metadata伪造admin secret
items.impact_scope: AI网关/代理服务，内网横向跳板
items.description: ### Summary An authenticated user with `internal_user` privileges can escalate to `proxy_admin` and achieve remote code execution. An attacker exploits this by requesting a new API key with a crafted metadata field containing a forged admin credential as the "secret" value.

items.title: agno eval代码注入RCE
items.summary_zh: 可影响FunctionCall字段的攻击者通过eval执行任意Python代码，控制Agno进程
items.action_zh: 升级至2.3.24，校验输入并禁用eval
items.repro_note: 构造FunctionCall的field_type传入eval表达式，需可影响该字段
items.description: ### Impact Agno versions prior to 2.3.24 contain an arbitrary code execution vulnerability in the model execution component. The `field_type` parameter on a `FunctionCall` input field was passed to Python's built-in `eval()`, allowing an attacker who could influence that value to execute arbitrary Python code in the Agno process.

items.title: REDAXO 认证绕过接管后台
items.title_zh: REDAXO 认证绕过接管后台
items.summary_zh: 未授权攻击者可伪造临时登录token冒充admin，获取后台权限并执行代码
items.action_zh: 升级至5.21.4并限制后台访问
items.repro_note: 伪造临时登录token，需structure/history插件与可预测secret
items.description: REDAXO core from 5.3.0 before 5.21.4 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the structure/history plugin that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge temporary login tokens. Attackers can force the session-tied secret into a predictable state and forge tokens for accounts like admin, gaining backend access and code execution outside live mode.

items.title: nest-admin 硬编码JWT认证绕过
items.summary_zh: 未授权攻击者用硬编码JWT_SECRET签发admin令牌，冒充任意用户获取后台权限
items.action_zh: 升级至1.0.1，更换JWT密钥并轮换令牌
items.impact_scope: 后台管理框架，内网系统常见
items.description: nest-admin before 1.0.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge administrator tokens by using a hardcoded JWT_SECRET committed in .env.production. Attackers can sign tokens with the known secret that JwtStrategy and RbacGuard trust, impersonating any user ID or claiming the admin role for full administrative access.
